stories.story_fr: Le 20 mai 2026, Intuit annonce une reduction de ses effectifs a temps plein d'environ 17% pour devenir une entreprise plus rapide, plus legere et plus concentree, en accelerant sa plateforme AI-native autour de ses 3 Big Bets.
stories.story_en: On May 20, 2026, Intuit announced it is reducing its full-time workforce by approximately 17% to become a faster, leaner and more focused company, accelerating its AI-native platform around its 3 Big Bets.
stories.signal: Today, we are reducing our full-time workforce by approximately 17%.

stories.story_fr: Intuit cible le segment des entreprises mid-market avec sa plateforme ERP AI-native (Intuit Enterprise Suite), un segment qui croit de plus de 30% selon le CEO Sasan Goodarzi.
stories.story_en: Intuit is targeting mid-market businesses with its AI-native ERP platform (Intuit Enterprise Suite), a segment growing north of 30% according to CEO Sasan Goodarzi.
stories.signal: serving mid-market businesses that are growing north of 30 percent

stories.story_fr: Sur l'exercice 2025, le revenu TurboTax Live a bondi de 47% a 2,0 Mds $, illustrant la disruption par Intuit du segment de la declaration fiscale assistee via l'IA et l'expertise humaine.
stories.story_en: In fiscal 2025, TurboTax Live revenue jumped 47% to $2.0 billion, illustrating Intuit's disruption of the assisted tax category through AI and human expertise.
stories.signal: TurboTax Live revenue 47 percent to $2.0 billion
